args.title: Fix export button staying greyed out after failed export
args.body:
File: src/Report.ts

The issue is that after a failed export, the Export button remains greyed out and unclickable until the page is reloaded. While the file src/Report.ts currently only defines a Report interface, the fix will involve ensuring that any state tracking export success or failure properly resets to allow retrying an export.

Proposed change: Review and update the relevant methods handling export status in or related to src/Report.ts to reset the Export button state upon export failure, ensuring the button becomes active again for retry without needing a page reload.
